about: The map of the ORIGINAL objects of SheepD3D.exe in link order. 'file' is the source file that rebuilds the object. Ranges are [start, end) of the object's contributions; text_comdats are the COMDATs placed after its main .text. Uncertain boundaries are in each object's notes; entries with "standin" are stand-ins for objects whose code the linker discarded (tools/standin.py).

The $E 0x401030 is XCU slot 0x579004 (first) and defines g_camera 0x584c50, the first .bss contribution. objects.notes: The extent from 0x401030 on is certain; whether 0x401000-0x401030 belongs to this object is undecided (rich count). The .data includes an unreferenced u16=1 at 0x57910e. The .bss runs 0x584c50-0x585066 plus a 2-byte pad; it is bounded by g_camera (proved by its $E) and by D3DApp's g_limiterTimer 0x585068 (proved by its $E), and InputDevice uses nothing in it. It also defines the loader/screen globals 0x584fc0 and 0x58502c-0x585063. | DX_IsVersionOk 0x401000-0x401030 as its own /O2 object (C or C++) ahead of app_main is one of the Rich-count candidates (+1).
